factors.label: Annual mean NDVI
factors.source: MODIS/Terra MOD13C2 v061 monthly NDVI 0.05 deg CMG, 2025 (NASA LP DAAC)

factors.label: Mean slope (463 m posts, 0.5 degree window)
factors.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (ESA, 2021 release), elevation and water body mask

factors.label: Elevation standard deviation (463 m posts, 0.5 degree window)
factors.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (ESA, 2021 release), elevation and water body mask

factors.label: Dominant rock class
factors.source: GLiM v1.0 global lithological map, 0.5 degree grid (Hartmann & Moosdorf 2012, PANGAEA)

grid.landMask: Natural Earth 1:10m land polygons minus lake polygons, rasterised at 0.05 degrees; a cell is land when at least 5% of it is land

ndvi.source: MODIS/Terra MOD13C2 v061 monthly NDVI 0.05 deg CMG, 2025 (NASA LP DAAC)
ndvi.method: Mean of monthly cell means. Land pixels with pixel reliability 0, 1 or 2 only; cloudy and climatology-filled pixels are left out.

terrain.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 (ESA, 2021 release), elevation and water body mask
terrain.window: one 0.5 degree cell: 55.6 km north-south by 55.6 km x cos(latitude) east-west
terrain.method: Elevation block-averaged to 15 arc-second (463 m) posts (via the product's 2x2-mean overview), water pixels left out. slope = mean Horn 3x3 slope in degrees; roughness = standard deviation of elevation in m. Code: pipeline/terrain_metrics.py

lithology.source: GLiM v1.0 global lithological map, 0.5 degree grid (Hartmann & Moosdorf 2012, PANGAEA)
lithology.method: Cell value as published in the authors' 0.5 degree grid. Water bodies (11) and no data (15) become null.

landcover.source: MODIS Terra+Aqua MCD12C1 v061 yearly land cover 0.05 deg CMG, 2025, IGBP classes (NASA LP DAAC)
landcover.method: Mean of the IGBP class percent over the cell's land pixels, divided by 100. Used by the bare-ground rule for cells where ndvi is null (data/SCHEMA.md).

landCover.source: MODIS Terra+Aqua MCD12C1 v061 yearly land cover 0.05 deg CMG, 2025, IGBP classes (NASA LP DAAC)
landCover.method: Mean of the IGBP class percent over the cell's land pixels, divided by 100. Used by the bare-ground rule for cells where ndvi is null (data/SCHEMA.md).
